title: Why do world models matter?
summary: They can make simulation, planning, experimentation and embodied-AI training more accessible.
body: World models could reduce the cost of high-quality simulation and physical experimentation, improve infrastructure and crisis planning, provide training environments for embodied AI, support scientific and industrial experimentation and become shared infrastructure for smaller organisations.

claims: They can make simulation, planning, experimentation and embodied-AI training more accessible.
